exposure: Infants with positive COVID-19 PCR test
outcome: Clinical presentation of COVID-19 in pregnancy
cohort: 24 pregnant women admitted to the Cantonal Hospital in Zenica, Bosnia and Herzegovina, between April 30, 2020 and April 30, 2021
finding: COVID-19 in pregnancy was usually asymptomatic or mild but associated with high rates of preterm birth, NICU admissions, and intrauterine fetal death.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was performed in 75% of the women, with previous caesarean section being the most common indication (54.2%).
